experiences.description:
•	Managed conception, template, product selection, and reporting for marketing e-mails in MailChimp based on Goggle Analytics. Graphic design and email creation in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.

•	Overlook Ecommerce Merchandising team in the proper execution of product imports to the websites, suppressed listings and imports in Amazon. Training and development of product management for all sites.

•	Customer Service manager for SwimSpot E-commerce department. Supervisor in charge overseeing the team in
order processing, fulfillment, returns, and customer inquiries.
Customer service and cashier for a high volume of guest flow per hour.

•	Responsible for planning, organizing, and managing all major and minor floor set projects for six stores. 
•	Analyzed sales reports to set shipment of new merchandise in the stores everyday.
•	Partnered with merchandise planners to manage inventory levels on the sales floor.
•	Styled all mannequins, windows, and displays. 
•	Educated management team on new products, visual updates, and current store trends.

•	Organized Nancy Pipkin Design's office that included fabric library, portfolios, show archives, and   
        costumes.

•	Assisted costume designer with sewing, basic fitting, buying, and pulling of costumes for the production of "The Snow Queen."
